Reconstructed all 216 integral dual inequalities with nonnegative pair weights total 486 over 108 pairs and telescoping vertex potentials: 6m<=486+72=558, hence m<=93. Independent direct circular enumeration checked 93 distinct, nonpalindromic and reversal-disjoint windows of the given 93-symbol witness, proving least period 93. Exhaustive finite 243-word graph is the entire fixed-parameter domain, not a heuristic sample.
